newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Pep Boys EPS view trimmed.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Pep Boys EPS view trimmed.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc, citing weather-related factors, said Monday it reduced its earnings per share estimates on Pep Boys -- Manny, Moe & Jack to $0.35 from $0.37 for the January 31, 1997 Q4 and to $1.61 from $1.63 for the full FY97.
--Analyst Beth Richard in a report said she was maintaining her FY98 EPS estimate of $1.98.
--"Since the estimate reduction is purely weather related and not, in our opinion, a demand issue, we would utilize this weakness in the stock to be more aggressive."
--Shares of Pep Boys, an auto parts retail chain, were at 28-1/2, off 1-3/8.
